scripts.build: node scripts/generate.mjs && vite build && node scripts/check-build.mjs
scripts.format: prettier --write src scripts tests docs *.json *.ts README.md .github/workflows/*.yml
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src scripts tests docs *.json *.ts README.md .github/workflows/*.yml
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build && npm run format:check
